question: Does an existing Swedish catalogue identify a different archived fragment containing the hymn Lucis huius festa, suitable for a targeted comparison of Fr 8073?

raw_records.schäden: Beschnitten oben und unten. 1r Text seitlich radiert.
raw_records.anmerkungen: Drei schwarze und eine rote Notenlinie. Entstehungsort  "Deutschland? / Baltikum?" auf Grund der Notation "Schweden?" laut CCM.
raw_records.inhalt: 1rv Proprium de sanctis: Annae hy AH 52, Nr. 101; hy AH 52, Nr. 104.
Mariae v.; Hist. rhythm.: Novum vas es veterum; hy: O gloriosa domina. - Annae; hy: Lucis huius festa; off. rhythm.: Celeste beneficium

interpretation: Fr 20441/Ant 189 is a catalogue-reported witness, not an independent reading of the disputed stanza and not a new same-book hypothesis. The MPO catalogue identifies Fr 8073 by AH 52 no.101, previously identified as this hymn; BOMPAC assigns the fragments to different reconstruction units, not proof of physical separation. The exact hymn extent and words in Fr 20441 remain unverified.
